name: dispatches_registered_agent
why: Phase 0 of the agent-extraction plan: the wrapper dispatches the registered agent, not a hand-rolled general-purpose prompt.

name: no_general_purpose
why: The whole point of the split is that spec-review no longer hand-rolls a general-purpose subagent.

name: has_silent_return_gate
why: Phase 0 anti-silence class: a return with no STATUS line or an empty body is a named, audited outcome, not a hang.

name: needs_attention_uses_task_state_cli
why: v3.6.0 wave 2 follow-up: persistent spec-review findings route the needs-attention transition through the task-state CLI instead of a hand-Edit.

name: render_provenance_negation
why: v3.11.0 context-conflation fix: the render-before-ask rule must state the negative — Read results, subagent returns, dossier files, and SendMessage payloads are not 'shown to the user'. Anchors the same phrase check_render_before_ask requires.

name: render_before_ask_rule
why: v3.11.0: capability skills were out of scope in v3.8.0; any skill body mentioning AskUserQuestion now states the render-before-ask rule.

name: over_build_hardening_sentence
why: v3.13.0 counterweight: quality-hardening beyond an AC (guards for inputs never accepted, abstractions for absent use cases, speculative indexes) is OVER-BUILT, not robustness.
